snippet.title: TOWER INC. | Underground Corporate Horror (Official Trailer 2026)
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Company. In Tower Inc., the job description is simple: Get in, secure the assets, and get out alive. But the building is watching, and the "underground" is deeper than you think.

WISHLIST TOWER INC. ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2261310/Tower_Inc/

Tower Inc. is an atmospheric, industrial horror experience. Navigate a shifting corporate nightmare filled with deadly traps, mechanical terrors, and a ticking clock that never stops.

Key Features:

Industrial Stealth: Use the environment to hide from things that shouldn't exist.
